title: A training-set statistic S that predicts the held-out gain of the shared bias-only correction (I3-2 M_bias), with a prospective test on new simulated datasets of controlled shared vs device-specific misspecification
status: pre-registered before any S value was computed on any dataset and before any relation between S and an outcome was examined. The dataset-level outcomes of the existing datasets (step 2) were known when this file was written (sky130 77 K GMR 0.769; IHP SG13G2 measured 1.11-1.34; TU Delft 295 K 0.797, 4.13 K 0.939; GF180 / IHP tier c 0.880 / 0.885; tier b 0.996 / 0.985), so step 2 is a retrospective, exploratory calibration. Step 3 (new datasets) is the prospective test; its rule coefficients are frozen in a dated amendment written after step 2 and before any step-3 data are generated
question: Post-hoc reading of I3-2, I5-1 and I6-1: the shared correction lowers held-out RRMS when the residual of the per-device fitted card is largely common across devices as a function of bias, and not when it is device-specific. Can a statistic computed from the training devices of a fold alone predict the held-out log gain ln(M_bias / C0_refit) of that fold and of a dataset?

definitions.records: every statistic uses only the starting-card records (e1_correction.DeviceRec: one simulation of the starting card on the measured or truth bias grid, the target current, trim start, paper denominator, frozen inclusion) of the TRAINING devices of a fold, i.e. exactly the records the fold's M_bias was trained on. No held-out device record, refit card or outcome enters S
definitions.residual: per training device d and included trimmed point p (curves with included = true and den > 0, points from the trim start; target cleaned with metrics.clean_current; points with non-finite target or simulation dropped): r_p = clip(ln((|I_target,p| + 1e-13) / (|I_sim,p| + 1e-13)), -1, 1). The clip is the range of g = tanh(.) of M_bias
definitions.weight: w_p = (|I_target,p| / den_c)^2 / (n_c * C_d), den_c the curve's paper denominator, n_c the number of trimmed points of the curve, C_d the device's number of included curves. sum_p w_p (r_p - g_p)^2 is the first-order quadratic form of the M_bias loss term of device d (mean over curves of trimmed RMSE / den), since I_sim e^g - I_target = I_target (e^(g - r) - 1) ~ I_target (g - r)
definitions.common_bias_grid: square bins of width 0.1 in (|Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD) (the M_bias inputs 1 and 2), bin index min(floor(x / 0.1), 11), 12 x 12 bins, kept separate per polarity (M_bias input 0)
definitions.shared_function: m_A(polarity, bin) = sum_{e in A, same polarity} sum_{p in bin} w_p r_p / sum_{e in A, same polarity} sum_{p in bin} w_p; m = 0 in a bin with no point of A
definitions.energy: E_d(m) = sum_p w_p (r_p - m(polarity_d, bin_p))^2; E_d(0) = sum_p w_p r_p^2
definitions.S1_lodo: PRIMARY. On the training set D of a fold: S1_lodo(D) = 1 - sum_{d in D} E_d(m_{D minus d}) / sum_{d in D} E_d(0). The fraction of the training devices' residual energy that the shared bias function, estimated without the scored device, explains. Can be negative (the shared function estimated from the other devices increases the residual of d)
definitions.S1_pooled: secondary: S1 with m_D (in-sample; the scored device is in the estimate)
definitions.S2: secondary: mean over same-polarity device pairs (d, e) in D of the uncentered weighted cosine between their bin-mean residual vectors a_d(b) = sum_{p in b} w_p r_p / W_d(b), on the bins where both W_d(b), W_e(b) > 0, bin weight sqrt(W_d(b) W_e(b)): cos = sum u a_d a_e / sqrt(sum u a_d^2 * sum u a_e^2); pairs with a zero denominator skipped
definitions.S3: secondary: inner leave-one-group-out post-hoc gain of the M_bias recipe on D: for each inner group h of D (inner grouping = the outer fold unit of the dataset: device on sky130 REAL_DEV and IHP measured, W/L group on TU Delft, geometry on GF180 / IHP simulated), M_bias (3-16-16-1, I3-2 recipe) trained on D minus h with the reduced recipe 1 seed (0) and 500 Adam steps (all other I3-2 hyperparameters unchanged), applied post hoc (no refit) to the starting-card simulation of each device of h; S3(D) = mean over devices of D of ln(RRMS_corrected / RRMS_start) (strict paper RRMS, e1_correction.score_device). Negative = gain. Reduced recipe because the full recipe (5 seeds, 2000 steps) costs about 3 CPU h per simulated dataset of 48 targets
definitions.primary_choice_and_reason: S1_lodo is primary. (1) It measures the quantity in the post-hoc reading directly: the part of the per-device fitted-card residual that is common across devices as a function of polarity and normalized terminal bias, the M_bias inputs. (2) The weights make it the quadratic form of the M_bias training loss, so it measures residual that matters to the paper metric, not residual at currents near zero. (3) The leave-one-device-out estimate removes the in-sample inflation of a pooled fraction (S1_pooled reaches 1 with one device per polarity) and estimates transfer to an unseen device, the quantity the held-out gain measures. (4) It is deterministic, needs no training and no simulation, and costs milliseconds per fold. S3 is closer to the method but is stochastic, uses a reduced recipe and costs CPU hours; S2 ignores the residual magnitude per bin and the absolute level of the residual relative to its total energy
definitions.sign_convention: outcome y = ln(M_bias / C0_refit) (negative = gain). Expected direction: higher S1_lodo, S1_pooled, S2 -> lower y (negative rank correlation); higher S3 -> higher y (positive rank correlation)

outcomes.fold_outcome: y_f = mean over the held-out devices of fold f of ln(rrms_M_bias / rrms_C0_refit), devices with a non-finite or non-positive value of either left out
outcomes.dataset_outcome: y_D = ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) = mean over all held-out devices of the dataset of ln(rrms_M_bias / rrms_C0_refit) (i3_2_bias.paired_ratio convention)
outcomes.dataset_S: S_D = mean over folds of S_f weighted by the number of held-out devices of the fold (equal weights when folds have equal size)

step2_retrospective.label: retrospective calibration on outcomes already seen; exploratory

datasets.sky130_77K: REAL_DEV 12 devices, records out/research/explore/E1/real_dev.{npz,json}; 12 leave-one-device-out folds, training = the other 11; outcomes out/research/explore/I3_2/real_dev/results.json per_device.M_bias, per_device.C0_refit
datasets.ihp_meas_{233,300,343,398}K: I5-1 DEV 18 devices per temperature, records out/research/explore/I5_1/start/records_{T}K.{npz,json}; 18 leave-one-device-out folds, training = the other devices of the held-out device's class (lv / hv), as in I5-1; outcomes out/research/explore/I5_1/lodo_{T}K/results.json per_device
datasets.tudelft_{4,295}K: I6-1 DEV 45 devices per temperature, records out/research/explore/I6_1/start/records_{T}K.{npz,json}; 7 leave-one-W/L-group-out folds, training = the other 6 groups; outcomes out/research/explore/I6_1/lodo_{T}K/results.json per_device
datasets.gf180_c, ihp_c: tier c sets 0-2 (48 targets), records out/research/explore/E1/{pdk}_c_set{0,1,2}; 16 leave-one-geometry-out folds; outcomes out/research/explore/I3_2/{pdk}_c_logo/results.json per_device
datasets.gf180_b, ihp_b: tier b sets 0-2 (48 targets), records out/research/explore/I3_2/followup/f2_{pdk}_b/records/{pdk}_b_set{0,1,2}; 16 leave-one-geometry-out folds; outcomes out/research/explore/I3_2/followup/f2_{pdk}_b/results.json M_bias.per_device, C0_refit.per_device

step2_retrospective.n: 11 datasets, 162 folds (12 + 4 x 18 + 2 x 7 + 4 x 16). The IHP measured temperatures share devices, as do the TU Delft temperatures; dataset points are not independent
step2_retrospective.reported: per dataset: mean S1_lodo, S1_pooled, S2 (and S3 when its queue job has run), y_D, GMR, n folds, n held-out devices; Spearman rank correlation of S_D with y_D over the 11 datasets for each S; fold-level Spearman over the 162 folds (pooled) and within each dataset; OLS fits
step2_retrospective.frozen_rule: the OLS line y_D = a + b * S1_lodo_D over the 11 datasets (dataset level). Its coefficients a, b and the zero crossing t* = -a / b are written to a dated amendment out/research/explore/I7_1/prereg_amendment_<date>.json before any step-3 data are generated. Rule: predicted sign of the log gain = sign(a + b * S1_lodo_D); predicted gain (M_bias better than C0_refit) iff a + b * S1_lodo_D < 0. The rule is frozen whatever its sign of b and fit quality; the amendment states both
step2_retrospective.S3_note: S3 needs a queue job (about 35 min). The rule uses S1_lodo only, so the amendment is written from S1 / S2 values; S3 retrospective values are added to the step-2 results when the job has run and do not change the frozen rule

step3_prospective.label: prospective test; data generated after the rule is frozen
step3_prospective.generator: scripts/research/explore/i7_1_transfer.py --mode truth (src/cryoml/explore/i7_1_transfer.py). Per PDK (GF180 BSIM4 ngspice-41, IHP SG13G2 PSP103 ngspice-46), replicate r in {0, 1} and mixing level lambda in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}: one truth set of the 16 pdk2 devices (8 nMOS, 8 pMOS geometries of the PDK). Base: the make_truth tier-a draw (seven fitted parameters uniform in the device's seven-parameter box, other card values stock, 27 C, no extrinsic resistance), seed 970001 + PDK offset (0 GF180, 500000 IHP) + 10000 r + device index. Observed current at every point of the 11 canonical curves: I_obs = I_clean * exp(e_d(x1, x2)) * (1 + 0.01 N(0, 1)), x1 = |Vgs| / VDD, x2 = |Vds| / VDD, e_d = A (sqrt(lambda) s_pol(d) + sqrt(1 - lambda) u_d), A = 0.10
step3_prospective.error_functions: s_nmos, s_pmos (shared within a polarity) and u_d (one per device) are random Fourier feature functions f(x) = c sum_{k=1..16} a_k cos(omega_k . x + beta_k), omega_k ~ N(0, I / 0.35^2), a_k ~ N(0, 1), beta_k ~ U(0, 2 pi), c such that the RMS over the 21 x 21 uniform grid of [0, 1]^2 is 1. Seeds: s_pol base + 5000 + (0 nMOS, 1 pMOS), u_d base + 6000 + device index, noise base + 7000 + device index (base = 970001 + PDK offset + 10000 r). The five lambda levels of one (PDK, replicate) share the base cards, s_pol, u_d and noise draws (paired design: only lambda changes). lambda is the expected fraction of the injected error variance that is shared within a polarity
step3_prospective.truth_location: out/research/pdk2/truth/i7_1_r{r}_l{100 lambda:03d}/set_0.npz (GF180) and out/research/pdk2/ihp_truth/i7_1_r{r}_l{100 lambda:03d}/set_0.npz (IHP), make_truth layout, so the stored pipeline code (e1_collect_pdk2.collect, i2_1_joint heldout refit) reads them unchanged
step3_prospective.pipeline_per_dataset: the I3-2 / F2 tier-b pipeline unchanged: starting fits e1_collect_pdk2.collect (wide box, polish max_nfev 300, irls 3, start = truth projection); leave-one-geometry-out over the 16 targets (16 folds of 1 target, training = the other 15, both polarities); M_bias I3-2 recipe (3-16-16-1, 5 seeds 0-4, 2000 steps); C0_refit and M_bias held-out refits (polish max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01); strict paper RRMS with target-frozen inclusion
step3_prospective.n: 2 PDKs x 2 replicates x 5 levels = 20 datasets, 320 targets, 320 folds
step3_prospective.statistics: per fold S1_lodo, S1_pooled, S2 from the 15 training records; S3 in a separate, later queue job; S_D = mean over the 16 folds; y_D = ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) over the 16 targets

prediction.P1_rank: Spearman rank correlation between S1_lodo_D and y_D over the 20 datasets <= -0.50
prediction.P2_sign: the frozen step-2 rule sign(a + b * S1_lodo_D) equals sign(y_D) in >= 15 of the 20 datasets (0.75)
prediction.verdict: supported if P1 and P2 hold; partially supported if exactly one holds; not supported if neither holds
prediction.failed_targets: a target whose M_bias or C0_refit RRMS is non-finite is left out of y_D (paired_ratio convention) and counted; a dataset with more than 4 of 16 targets left out is excluded from P1 and P2 and counted against P2 (counted as a wrong sign)

secondary_reported_not_deciding: fold-level Spearman of S1_lodo_f with y_f over the 320 folds and within each PDK
P1 and P2 computed with S1_pooled, S2 and S3 (for S3 the expected sign is positive; S3 has no frozen rule, rank test only)
manipulation check: Spearman(lambda, S1_lodo_D), Spearman(lambda, y_D)
mean absolute error of the linear rule's predicted y_D
starting-card RRMS and C0_refit RRMS per dataset
permutation p-value (10000 permutations, default_rng(0)) of the dataset-level Spearman

data_protection: REAL_TEST (sky130) and the I5-1 / I6-1 TEST splits are not loaded by any I7-1 script. Step 2 reads only stored DEV / simulated records and stored DEV result files
compute: step 2 S1 / S2: no simulation, seconds. S3 retrospective: one queue job (about 35 min, 6 workers). Step 3: truth generation (64 base simulations), then one queue job per (PDK, replicate) (5 datasets, about 25 min each), S3 on the new datasets (about 50 min), decide. Total about 3 to 3.5 h of queue time; one heavy job at a time through out/research/queue.txt
frozen_choices_note: Everything above is fixed before any S value exists. Changes get a dated amendment that leaves this file unchanged
